---

```{r instalar_paquetes, eval=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("muscData")
```

```{r librerias}
library(Seurat)
library(muscData)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r cargar_datos}
sce <- Kang18_8vs8()
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts(sce), meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(sce)),
                          project = "Kang_IFNb", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```

```{r preparar_metadatos}
obj$donor_id <- as.character(obj$ind)
obj$condition <- toupper(as.character(obj$stim))
obj$cell_type <- as.character(obj$cell)
obj$sample_id <- paste(obj$donor_id, obj$condition, sep = "_")
```

```{r resumen_dataset}
cat("Células del dataset:", ncol(sce), "\nCélulas tras el filtro inicial:", ncol(obj),
    "\nPacientes en total:", n_distinct(obj$donor_id), "\n")
obj[[]] %>% distinct(donor_id, condition) %>% count(condition, name = "pacientes")
```
```{r}
pseudo <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "RNA", group.by = c("sample_id", "condition","cell_type"))$RNA
dim(pseudo)
as.matrix(pseudo[1:10, 1:6])
```

```{r}
meta_pb <- obj[[]] %>%
  count(condition, sample_id, cell_type, donor_id, name = "n_cells")
# Seurat reemplaza los guiones bajos dentro de cada etiqueta por guiones

# rownames(meta_pb) <- with(meta_pb, paste(condition, gsub("_", "-", sample_id),
#                                       gsub("_", "-", cell_type), sep = "_"))

rownames(meta_pb) <- with(meta_pb, paste(paste0("g",gsub("_","-",sample_id)), 
                                         condition, gsub("_", "-", cell_type), sep = "_"))

meta_pb <- meta_pb[colnames(pseudo), ]
meta_pb$condition <- factor(meta_pb$condition, levels = c("CTRL", "STIM"))
head(meta_pb)
```

```{r}
coldata <- subset(meta_pb, cell_type = "CD14+ Monocytes" & n_cells >= 20,
                  select = c(donor_id,condition,sample_id,n_cells))
coldata$donor_id <- factor(coldata$donor_id)

counts_mono <- as.matrix(pseudo[, rownames(coldata), drop = FALSE])
table(coldata$donor_id, coldata$condition)
```
